title: Vampire Vape  Rum Tobacco 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape Rum Tobacco Shortfill combines the deep richness of Tobacco with the warming sweetness of spiced Rum. The Tobacco base delivers earthy intensity, while the Rum adds subtle caramel-like depth for a refined finish. With its 70VG/30PG ratio, this 100ml shortfill is ideal for direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping using sub-ohm kits, producing thicker clouds and smooth flavour delivery. Supplied in a 120ml bottle with 100ml of e-liquid, there’s space for two 10ml nicotine shots to adjust strength as required. Proudly made in the UK, Vampire Vape are renowned for their creative e-liquids. The Tobacco collection showcases their ability to pair classic Tobacco with complementary accents.
